candidates.visible_reason: The exposed end face of the wooden tie shows many radial and branching cracks. One long dark crack runs diagonally across the face, with finer checks around it. The grain looks weathered and rough.
candidates.uncertainty: medium: the end face is clearly visible and sharp, but I cannot tell whether the cracks are shallow seasoning checks or deeper structural damage from this angle.
alternatives: normal seasoning checks in hardwood end grain
